title: Value produced by the last gate
statement: Let $f$ assign a value to each gate and current value list, let $g$ be a gate, and let $v$ be an initial value list. For any finite gate list $G$ and default value $d$, the value at index $|v|+|G|$ after evaluating $G$ followed by $g$ is $f(g,w)$, where $w$ is the list obtained by evaluating $G$ starting from $v$.
